text: Ages ranging from 16 to 35 (calculated uniformly as of September 1, 2024). The maximum age limit for in-service Chinese teachers maybe extended to 45.Language RequirementApplicants should have a minimum score of 180 in HSK test (Level 4) and HSKK score.Chinese Bridge' winners who have been awarded International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship Certificate can apply for admission according to the scholarship specified in the certificate. Please consult chinesebridge@chinese.cn concerning scholarship awarding.
